brand.name: Budgetly
hero.title: Your next budget app should feel premium from day one.
hero.description: Budgetly is designed for people who want clarity, control, and confidence in every financial decision. One dashboard for income, bills, spending, and goals.
section.headline: A premium budgeting experience built for scale.
section.subline: Move beyond spreadsheets with an intelligent, mobile-ready workflow that keeps you on track every month.
section.meta: Fast setup · Real-time clarity · Elegant controls
feature.fixed.title: Fixed charges
feature.fixed.text: Rent, bills, subscriptions — set a monthly cap once and track it automatically.
feature.variable.title: Variable spending
feature.variable.text: Groceries, fuel, family, going out — log expenses in two taps as they happen.
feature.savings.title: Savings goals
feature.savings.text: Give every goal a target and a source, and watch the progress bar fill up.
feature.overview.title: One clear overview
feature.overview.text: Budget, spent, remaining, and saved — the four numbers that actually matter.
promo.headline: Turn monthly planning into dependable results.
promo.text: Budgetly replaces complex trackers with clear categories, automated rollovers, and built-in savings planning so you can focus on growth.
promo.trackText: A single source of truth for income, spending, and obligations.
promo.forecastText: Know what you can safely spend across the whole month.
promo.protectText: Keep savings ahead of recurring payments and big events.
promo.notifyText: Smart alerts for overspending, due dates, and budget gaps.
pricing.headline: Premium pricing for professionals.
pricing.text: Start with the free plan, then upgrade when your budget requires smarter insights and team-ready tools.
pricing.meta: No hidden fees · Cancel anytime · Secure by default
plan.starter.tagline: For one person keeping it simple.
